create_mock_environment: create a MockEnvironment instance with observation shape, action shape, min and max episode duration
reset_mock_environment: reset the MockEnvironment to start a new episode with a random duration between min and max
step_mock_environment: step the MockEnvironment with an action and receive observation, reward, done flag, and info dict
test_observation_space: test the MockEnvironment observation_space property to verify it returns a gym Box space with correct bounds
test_action_space: test the MockEnvironment action_space property to verify it returns a gym Box space with correct bounds
